name: Segmented
summary: 2–4 mutually exclusive options on one row. The 'tabs but for a control' pattern. Active segment lifts above the sunken bar with surface.raised + shadow.xs.

options.description: Array of { label, value, icon? } for 2–4 options.

size.description: Density. md is rare — Segmented is usually sm so it sits beside other controls cleanly.

ariaLabel.description: Required if no surrounding label — describes what's being chosen.

keyboard: ArrowLeft — move focus AND select the previous segment
ArrowRight — move focus AND select the next segment
rules: Bar carries role='group' with an aria-label describing what's being chosen.
Each segment is a real <button type='button'> with aria-pressed.
ArrowLeft/Right inside the bar both move focus AND change value (toolbar pattern, not radio roving).
Icon-only segments require aria-label per segment.

do: Limit to 2–4 options. Past 4, the bar overflows or labels truncate.
Use short, scannable labels — single nouns or 1-word verbs.
Pair with a Field if you need a label or hint.
Animate active-segment shift with motion.transition.fast; honor prefers-reduced-motion.
dont: Don't use Segmented for booleans — use Toggle / Switch.
Don't use Segmented for radio semantics with form submission — use RadioGroup.
Don't put icon-only segments without an aria-label per segment.

changelog.note: Initial release. Promotes the v0.6 audit-dashboard primitive in inputs.tsx to a dedicated contract. <button>-based (not radio); single bar with lift-and-shadow active state.
